replaces: order_rule_v1 for new runs. order_rule_v1.json stays unchanged, for the record.
applies_to: 'rule' applies to course runs (no --pairs) with a neutral prompt; --pairs benchmark runs never use it. 'graph_check' applies to every validator run, benchmarks included.

rule.direction reverses: both directions proposed to the validator, order_agreement = reversed; never pick one automatically. Both stay in HUMAN_REVIEW.

left_out_of_other_links_cycle_and_redund: both links of a pair proposed in both directions, however it was found
a link flagged bidirectional by discovery
a link rejected on its scores alone
graph_check.still_counted: Links that scores alone would accept or send to review.
graph_check.kept: Every link stays in validated_graph.json with its decision. A link that is left out still gets a label, read against the counted links, but it cannot affect another link.
graph_check.dag: Only an ok link can be accepted, and ok links never form a cycle. Teacher accepts that would close a cycle are still refused (cdlp/validation/apply_review.py).

reasoning: A reversed pair cannot have both links true, so counting both as structure makes the cycle check report the model's disagreement rather than a cycle in the course. A link the checks have already rejected is not a claim the graph should act on, so it should not block or remove other links.
chosen_after: Chosen after seeing validation results for the demo course avl_demo under order_rule_v1, and with its deck text and target chain known. Not chosen on gold labels. No avl_demo number may be reported. Disclose this wherever the rule is described.

comparison_arms.reversed_pair_validator_pick: Pre-declared arm, not the default. For a reversed pair, accept a direction only if it would be accepted on its scores alone and the other would not; the losing direction is rejected. Otherwise both go to review. A winner on a cycle sends both to review. A winner cannot put other links on a cycle, and it does count for redundancy. No code computes this arm yet.

dropped_option: An evidence gate for links found in one order only was considered and dropped: it relies on the evidence grade to confirm a direction.
